subway-3-usage-scene-3.imageAlt: Photograph gap warning in a simple subway setting. Intended sense: A safety message warning passengers about the space between a train and the platform edge. No people or hands.

subway-1-usage-scene-4.reviewedScenario: A car here means one carriage of the train. Its door allows boarding, while an exit is the route out of the station. Omar asks for the way out after leaving the stationary train.

subway-1-usage-scene-4.imageAlt: Photograph exit in a simple subway setting. Intended sense: A doorway or route used to leave the station. No people or hands.
